tasks.title: Beyond Philosophy's Borders
paras: Metaphilosophy is a field that looks critically at whether philosophical inquiry can truly transcend cultural and linguistic boundaries. While traditional philosophy often aims to uncover universal truths, metaphilosophy questions whether such truths are even accessible across diverse contexts. Language, far from being a neutral vessel, shapes and limits how ideas are expressed and understood. A concept that resonates deeply in one culture may carry entirely different connotations—or none at all—in another. This raises concerns about the global applicability of philosophical frameworks developed in specific cultural milieus. Are we uncovering truths, or merely reinforcing culturally contingent assumptions?

Some insist that despite linguistic and cultural variation, certain philosophical concerns—like suffering, justice, or mortality—are shared across societies, suggesting a basis for universality. Yet even these themes may be interpreted through culturally specific lenses. Metaphilosophy doesn't deny the possibility of cross-cultural dialogue but cautions against assuming it is seamless. It encourages philosophers to examine how their methods and assumptions travel—or fail to—across contexts.

Critics worry this reflexivity may stall progress, but others see it as essential for avoiding intellectual overreach. By foregrounding these tensions, metaphilosophy aims not to dilute philosophy's aims, but to sharpen them through greater self-awareness and methodological rigor.

questions.stem: According to the passage, metaphilosophy challenges which of the following basic assumptions of philosophical inquiry?

options.A: The world can be understood through logical analysis.
options.B: Argumentation is a suitable tool for analyzing ideas.
options.C: Human experience is a good source of philosophical insight.
options.D: The conceptual tools that philosophy provides are universal.

questions.analysis: 解析：文章开篇即指出，传统哲学常旨在揭示普遍真理（“uncover universal truths”），而元哲学则质疑这些真理是否能跨越不同语境被获取（“questions whether such truths are even accessible across diverse contexts”），并担心在特定文化环境中发展出的哲学框架是否具有全球适用性。这直接挑战了哲学概念工具具有普遍性的假设。 选项分析： A. 世界可以通过逻辑分析来理解，文中未直接挑战此点。 B. 论证是分析思想的合适工具，文中未挑战此点。 C. 人类经验是哲学洞见的良好来源，文中未挑战此点。 D. 哲学提供的概念工具是普遍的，这正是元哲学所质疑的。

questions.stem: Why does the author note that concepts may carry different connotations across different cultures?

options.A: To support the claim that philosophical frameworks apply globally
options.B: To illustrate the idea of crossing cultural and linguistic boundaries
options.C: To provide a justification for metaphilosophical investigations
options.D: To challenge the claim that language affects how ideas are expressed

questions.analysis: 解析：作者在第一段指出语言塑造和限制思想的表达与理解后，紧接着举例说明概念在不同文化中可能有不同内涵。这个例子是为了具体说明前面提出的观点（语言非中性），进而引出对哲学框架全球适用性的担忧，并最终提出元哲学的核心问题。因此，这个例子是为元哲学的研究（即批判性地审视哲学能否超越文化界限）提供了理由和依据。 选项分析： A. 支持哲学框架具有全球适用性的主张，这与例子想要说明的“可能不适用”恰恰相反。 B. 说明跨越文化和语言界限的想法，例子本身是说明跨越的困难，而非“跨越”这个行为。 C. 为元哲学研究提供理由，符合上下文逻辑。 D. 挑战语言影响思想表达的说法，例子是用来支持而非挑战这个说法。

questions.stem: The word "milieus" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 解析：“milieus”意为“环境、背景、社会环境”。原文中“philosophical frameworks developed in specific cultural milieus”指“在特定文化环境/背景中发展出的哲学框架”。 选项分析： A. environments（环境）意思最接近。 B. categories（类别）：不符。 C. centers（中心）：不符。 D. identities（身份）：不符。

questions.stem: Identify the sentence in paragraph 2 that describes an argument against the claims of metaphilosophy. Select the sentence to make your choice.

options.A: Some insist that despite linguistic and cultural variation, certain philosophical concerns—like suffering, justice, or mortality—are shared across societies, suggesting a basis for universality.
options.B: Yet even these themes may be interpreted through culturally specific lenses.
options.C: Metaphilosophy doesn't deny the possibility of cross-cultural dialogue but cautions against assuming it is seamless.
options.D: It encourages philosophers to examine how their methods and assumptions travel—or fail to—across contexts.

questions.analysis: ​​​​​解析：元哲学的核心观点是质疑哲学真理、研究框架具备跨文化普遍性，认为不同文化语言会割裂思想理解。本题要求选出反对元哲学观点的句子，A 项以部分人的立场，提出人类共有痛苦、正义、死亡等核心哲学议题，证明哲学存在普遍共性，是针对元哲学的直接反驳。 选项分析： A. 部分人认为即便存在文化语言差异，人类共有核心哲学议题，为哲学普遍性提供依据，属于反对元哲学的论点，正确。 B. 说明共通主题也会被文化视角差异化解读，是支撑元哲学立场的内容，排除。 C. 阐述元哲学对跨文化对话的理性态度，属于元哲学自身观点，排除。 D. 介绍元哲学对哲学家研究的要求，贴合元哲学核心主张，排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following is one criticism of metaphilosophy mentioned in the passage?

options.A: It fails to challenge existing philosophical frameworks.
options.B: It may prevent philosophy from accomplishing its mission.
options.C: It is used by some philosophers to keep new ideas from becoming established.
options.D: It is incapable of evaluating ideas from diverse traditions.

questions.analysis: 解析：文章最后一段提到：“Critics worry this reflexivity may stall progress...”，即批评者担心这种（元哲学的）反思性可能会阻碍进步。“阻碍进步”可以理解为可能妨碍哲学完成其使命（如追求真理）。 选项分析： A. 它未能挑战现有的哲学框架，与元哲学 actively challenges 的立场相反。 B. 它可能阻碍哲学完成其使命，与“stall progress”意思相符。 C. 它被一些哲学家用来阻止新思想确立，文中未提及。 D. 它无法评估来自不同传统的观点，文中未提及，且元哲学正是鼓励审视跨语境问题。
